'''Charlie Squadron''' was a [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in service of the [[Dimok government]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], it was deployed to stop an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] task group from kidnapping both [[Dimok (people)|Dimok]] and [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] leaders, but failed largely due to the efforts of [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], who destroyed their squadron leader ''Charlie 1''.
